title: Dual Blades
description:
This mods add new weapon into the game called "Dual Blades"
What does have block and really fast attack speed
body:
Hi, this is my first ever mod for minecraft what adds new weapon called "Dual Blades"
This weapon has really fast attack speed and can't knockback mobs 
But that's why this weapon has block, with it you can block any damage 
Each dual blade has own defense precentage but each time you block damage it will use durability of your dual blade but it does not have cooldown for blocking and with block you can knockback mobs
